description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's history traversal features, especially the 'ancestry-path' functionality. It sets up test repositories, commits, branches, and performs various log and rev-list commands to verify correct behavior of ancestry path computations.

methods.name: test_merge
methods.description: Performs a test merge using 'git merge -s ours', tags the commit with the provided message, and sets up the scenario for subsequent tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test scenario, runs commands, and verifies success based on expected output.

methods.name: test_ancestry
methods.description: Runs 'git log' with specified arguments and compares the output to the expected list of commits or paths.
